title: custom:tile-card-pro
description: One entity (or none) as a tile, drawn the way its kind says: the icon, the name, one line under it with the value, the status and the secondary, and controls at the line's end. A slider below and a visual below the line (a plot, the sun's day, the forecast) take a second row. The kind is detected from the entity (its domain, then its device class) or set with `kind`; the entities it reads besides the card's own are its `inputs`. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant (name, secondary, icon, color, value, status, an image's src).

tile.description: A tile's keys: the card's, and a tile's in a tile group

kind.description: What the entity is, forced or one that is never detected (trend, grid, solar, car, appliance, a named cover or appliance). Left out: detected from the entity's domain and device class; `entity` turns every default off

running_above.description: appliance: the power (W) above which it runs

series.description: trend: the series, ids or objects (entity, name, color, rules, visibility)

status.description: The status: a text or a template, or false for none; on the line after the value, or a badge before the badges with status_badge. Default: the kind's status, else the matching rule's label. Its look is the card's

visual.description: The visual: behind the texts (glow, image, flow), or below the line in a second row (a plot of the history, a bar, a gauge, segments, the sun's day, the forecast); false for none. Left out: the kind's (a cover's, a robot's and the grid's drawings are the poster's only)

vertical.description: The icon on top, the name and the value with its status centred under it, the controls under them; as narrow as its controls let it be, two rows at least, three with a control. The poster type's line under the value is left out (a written `secondary` stays)

badges.description: Badges at the end of the first row, centred on the icon, always all of them: the name and the line give way. Entities or badges of your own

status_badge.description: The status as a badge before the badges (a tag in the card's colour), in place of on the line; it always shows: the entity's state where the kind and the rules give none

tileKeys.description: The tile's item: an entity's keys, less the icon and the visual, which are the card's places

icon.description: The icon: an icon's name (mdi:…, a template), { type: icon | image | flow, …, its own actions, its badge }, or false for no icon. Left out: the kind's. A name makes the place an icon, and is a default: a matching rule's icon wins

color.description: The card's colour. A default: a matching rule's colour wins. Template allowed

hover.description: Home Assistant's hover and press, as on its tile card: a light layer under a mouse, a ripple from where you press, a ring around the card while it has the keyboard's focus. false keeps it still

iconPlace.description: The tile's icon: an icon's name (mdi:…, a template), { type: icon | image | flow, … } with its own actions and the badge on it, or false for no icon. Left out: the kind's

iconThing.description: The tile's icon: the poster's icon options, its own actions, and the badge on it

ruleIconPlace.description: The icon while the rule matches: an icon's name, { type, … } or options to merge (the badge too), false for none; no actions

ruleIconThing.description: A rule's icon: as the tile's, without the icon's actions (a rule changes the look, not what a tap does)

rule.description: First matching rule wins, in the order written. Its colour and icon win over the card's; its icon and visual merge onto the card's as the places do (an object without type changes options only); its icon may set the badge

iconBadge.description: The badge on the icon. auto (the default): Home Assistant's, a thermostat's or humidifier's action, a person's zone, an unavailable entity; false: none; or one of your own: an icon and a colour, each a text or a template (an empty icon shows none; without a colour, the tile's)

icon.description: An mdi: icon, or a template that renders one (empty: no badge)

color.description: A colour token, a hex or a template; default: the tile's colour
